def calculate_A(a):
    k = len(a)
    A = 0
    for x in range(k):
        prod = 1
        for y in range(k):
            if x == y:
                continue
            prod *= (a[x] * a[y] - 1) / (a[x] - a[y])
        A += prod
    return A

# Test with different sets of a

]

for i, case in enumerate(test_cases):
    print(f"Case {i}: {calculate_A(case)}")
